import alpha from 'alpha';
import React from 'react';

findings.message: The imports in this file are not grouped and ordered the way the rest of the tree is. Every file opens with the same twenty-three named blocks in the same sequence, each under its own comment header and alphabetized inside itself, so a reader looking for where a symbol comes from goes to the block rather than reading the whole list, and a reviewer sees a new dependency land in the block that says what kind of dependency it is.
